verdict.rationale: LightSprint has no documented user-configurable event-to-action rule engine. The closest evidence is a fixed built-in automation (merged work moves to Done automatically), vaguely described 'reusable workflows' with no mention of triggers, and support for GitHub Actions, an external tool where event-triggered rules would actually be defined. Missing for 10: a native rule builder for defining triggers and actions, documentation of supported events and conditions, examples of user-authored automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
